state.objective: Determine why redis cache hit ratio dropped to 12% at 09:30 UTC.

context.content: db query latency p50=12ms p99=450ms during read traffic burst
Cache guidelines: always set jitter on keys with high QPS to prevent stampedes.

submitted_answer.answer: A synchronized cache-expiry stampede likely caused concurrent key expirations, driving the hit ratio to 12% and shifting read traffic to PostgreSQL, as shown by the latency burst.
